paper_title: ChARM Character-based Act-adaptive Reward Modeling for Advanced   Role-Playing Language Agents
caption: The character distribution in RoleplayPref consists of 3 primary categories and 13 subcategories.

model_annotations.Bulgarian: Диаграмата е кръгова диаграма, която представя разпределението на героите в набора данни RoleplayPref, включваща общо 13 категории. Категориите са представени от сектори, оцветени в различни нюанси: синьо за „Movie Characters“, светлосиньо за „Teleplay Characters“, синьо-зелено за „Novel Characters“, зелено за „Game Characters“, зелено-жълто за „Custom Characters“, жълто за „Scientists“, розово за „Athletes“, лилаво за "Writers", светлорозово за "Musicians“, светло-зелено за „Actors“, зелено-кафяво за „Influencers“, сиво-зелено за "Real Characters" и най-малък сектор в бял цвят, обозначен като "Comic Characters“. Визуално сегментите изглеждат подредени по намаляващ размер, започвайки със синьото на Movie Characters и завършвайки с малкия бял сектор Comic Characters. Няма легенда, етикети с проценти вътре в секторите или сектори, които са визуално подчертани.
model_annotations.English: This pie chart illustrates a distribution of character types within the RoleplayPref dataset. The chart is divided into thirteen slices, representing different categories of characters, with a central, larger slice labeled “Custom Characters.” The remaining slices are arranged around this central segment. These include “Comic Characters” (purple), “Movie Characters” (light blue), “Novel Characters” (blue), “Game Characters” (teal), “Teleplay Characters” (light blue), “Virtual Characters” (light blue), “Scientists” (green), “Athletes” (green), “Writers” (green), “Musicians” (green), “Actors” (green), “Influencers” (green), and “Real Characters” (green). The slices appear ordered by decreasing size, with “Custom Characters” being the largest. The chart includes a legend identifying each color with its corresponding character type, but percentages are not explicitly displayed within the slices.
model_annotations.German: Dieses Kreisdiagramm zeigt die Verteilung von Charaktertypen in RoleplayPref und besteht aus 16 Segmenten, die unterschiedlich gefärbt sind. Die Hauptkategorien sind Comic Characters (ein dunkelblaues Segment mit etwa 12,5 %), Movie Characters (ein hellblaues Segment mit etwa 12,5 %) und Custom Characters (ein hellgrünes Segment mit etwa 12,5 %). Die Subkategorien umfassen Teleplay Characters (ein blaugraues Segment), Novel Characters (ein blaues Segment), Game Characters (ein tiefblaues Segment), Virtual Characters (ein hellblaues Segment), Scientists (ein hellgrünes Segment), Athletes (ein grünes Segment), Writers (ein hellgrünes Segment), Musicians (ein rosafarbenes Segment), Actors (ein rosafarbenes Segment), Influencers (ein rosa Segment), Real Characters (ein hellgrünes Segment), Comic Characters (ein hellblaues Segment), Artists (ein rosafarbenes Segment) und die Kategorie „Custom Characters“ (ein hellgrünes Segment). Das Diagramm enthält eine Legende, die die Namen jedes Segments identifiziert, jedoch keine Prozentangaben innerhalb der Segmente. Die Segmente sind nach Größe ordnet, wobei die größeren Segmente an der Außenseite des Kreisdiagramms angeordnet sind.
